title: Revised 2023 county child estimates — original report comparison
description: Nine same-year comparisons between the original report Table 10 and the current source redistribution. These are release corrections, not changes between measurement years.
publicationPeriod: Map the Meal Gap 2026 source working edition
methodology: The original report transcription is retained with its table-part locators. Revised values come from the complete received county CSV. Differences use tenths of one percentage point; no significance inference is made.

source.title: OACAA Table 10 and revised Feeding America county estimates
source.locator: Technical brief physical pages 4–5; original report Table 10 and current HCI CSV 2023 rows.
source.note: The publisher states that the previous county release used the wrong unemployment year. This correction did not affect statewide results.
source.rights: Published statistical facts with attribution. Source representation and original URLs are retained; publisher branding and narrative are not licensed for reuse.
